text: Soon Teddy came running. <break time="0.8s" /> Down the path. <break time="0.8s" /> To play with Rikki. <break time="0.8s" /> Just then. <break time="0.8s" /> A tiny brown snake named Karait. <break time="0.8s" /> Moved in the dust. <break time="0.8s" /> At Rikkis feet. <break time="0.8s" /> Karait was small. <break time="0.8s" /> But his bite was as dangerous. <break time="0.8s" /> As a cobras bite. <break time="0.8s" /> Rikkis eyes grew red. <break time="0.8s" /> And he danced up to Karait. <break time="0.8s" /> With careful steps. <break time="0.8s" /> Karait struck at him. <break time="0.8s" /> But Rikki jumped on his back. <break time="0.8s" /> And bit him near the head. <break time="0.8s" /> Teddys mother picked Rikki up. <break time="0.8s" /> And hugged him. <break time="0.8s" /> Because he had saved her son. <break time="0.8s" /> That night he met Chuchundra. <break time="0.8s" /> A sad little muskrat. <break time="0.8s" /> Who always crept along the walls. <break time="0.8s" /> Nag is everywhere. <break time="0.8s" /> Cried Chuchundra. <break time="0.8s" /> Can you not hear him. <break time="0.8s" /> Rikki listened. <break time="0.8s" /> And heard a tiny scratch. <break time="0.8s" /> Like a snakes skin moving on bricks. <break time="0.8s" /> He crept to the bathroom. <break time="0.8s" /> Where Nag and Nagaina were whispering. <break time="0.8s" /> Outside a small drain hole. <break time="0.8s" /> When there are no people in the house. <break time="0.8s" /> The garden will be ours again. <break time="0.8s" /> Said Nagaina. <break time="0.8s" /> Go in quietly. <break time="0.8s" /> And bite the big man first. <break time="0.8s" /> She whispered.
